title: The Catch (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character portrait unhurried Perth ocean fishing triumph
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The catch is the moment everything the morning said was true
The line goes tight and something from the deep is coming through
The rod bends to the water and the reel begins to sing
The catch is every reason why the charter boats take wing

[Pre-Chorus]
Pete watches from the helm with the particular satisfaction
Of a man who put you on the fish — that's the whole transaction

[Chorus]
The catch, the catch
Forty metres down and now it's coming up to match
The catch, the catch
Every story on the deck starts with this
The line went tight and something sent its wish
And Pete had put the boat exactly where the fish were right
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
A snapper off the reef at thirty-seven metres in the blue
Takes its time about arriving and there's nothing you can do
But hold the line and trust the tackle and wait the long wait out
The catch is what happens when the patience works throughout

[Bridge]
The same man who nailed tiles onto rooftops in the heat
Has now transferred that patience to where the fishlines meet
The water and the moment — it's the same skill differently applied
The catch confirms what Pete knew when he let the land slide

[Outro]
The catch knows Pete was waiting… Pete knows the catch…
That's my boy
